name: talentlens-workspace
description: TalentLens — AI recruitment & talent intelligence platform

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('node:child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'talentlens/talentlens/server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'talentlens/talentlens/client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
